name: intone
description: Text to speech from a simulated airway, in about a megabyte. Runs in the browser.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p intone-chimera -p intone-creatures --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p dist && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/intone_chimera.wasm -o dist/intone_chimera.wasm && wasm-opt -O3 --enable-bulk-memory --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/intone_creatures.wasm -o dist/intone_creatures.wasm
scripts.build:js: bun scripts/clean-dist.ts && bun build src/index.ts src/web-speech.ts src/worker.ts src/speaker.ts src/kokoro.ts src/creatures.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --minify --splitting --external kokoro-js --external @huggingface/transformers && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:js && cp public/data/cmudict.txt.gz dist/
scripts.test: bun run build && cargo test --workspace && bun test --timeout 30000 src eval
scripts.lint: biome check . && cargo fmt -p intone-chimera -p intone-creatures --check && cargo clippy -p intone-chimera -p intone-creatures --no-deps --all-targets -- -D warnings
